info.title: Online Exam Proctoring & Management System (OEPMS)
info.description: Full-lifecycle web exam platform featuring role-based access, automated screen proctoring, auto-evaluation, dashboards, and AI concept help via Google Gemini.

post.description: Authenticate with email and password, return JWT token.

get.description: Return the profile of the authenticated user.

post.description: Admin creates a new user account.

schema.title: Response List Users Endpoint Users Get

delete.description: Admin deletes user with business rule checks.

get.description: List exams depending on user role.

schema.title: Response List Exams Endpoint Exams Get

post.description: Teacher schedules a new exam for their own subject.

get.description: List subjects assigned to current teacher (or all subjects for admin/hod).

post.description: Add a question to an exam.

put.description: Submit or update official answer key for exam.

post.description: Publish exam to students/parents. Checks question count and total marks sum.

get.description: Get exam questions without answer keys.

schema.title: Response Get Exam Paper Endpoint Exams  Exam Id  Paper Get

post.description: Student starts a new attempt for a published exam inside its window.

get.description: Get attempt details and saved answers.

put.description: Autosave student answers. Fails if attempt is locked or submitted.

post.description:
Receive proctoring violation event (TAB_SWITCH, FULLSCREEN_EXIT).

If attempt is In Progress, logs violation, sets flagged=true, status=Auto-Locked,
and automatically evaluates saved partial answers.
Submit attempt and calculate evaluation results.

get.description: List results accessible to the current user.
Get detailed result for a single attempt, including question review.
Student dashboard: marks, upcoming exams, attempt history.
Teacher dashboard: own subjects, attempts, averages, violation counts.
Parent dashboard: linked children exams and published results.
HOD all users and results reports with filters and pagination.

post.description: Student requests plain-language AI explanation for a wrongly answered question.

get.description: View past AI concept explanations for the logged in student.

put.description:
Admin updates a platform setting (e.g. AI_HELP_DAILY_LIMIT).

Validation:
- Numeric settings must be integers > 0.
